message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing SelfMem BEAM scores across refinement iterations and training-set sizes.","description":"The figure contains two line plots with official BEAM score on the vertical axis (labeled ticks from 0.44 to 0.52). Panel A plots optimizer iteration 0–8; panel B plots training conversations used, 1–9. In both, purple triangles show the best-observed score and circles show the average; shaded bands show the observed range. Horizontal dashed references mark the final-agent strategy at 0.497 (green) and Iter0 at 0.472 (gray-blue). A star marks the best-observed strategy: iteration 3 in A and training set size 6 in B. In A, the best-observed line rises from about 0.472 to about 0.508 at iteration 1, dips to about 0.484 at 2, peaks at the labeled 0.510 at 3, then stays around 0.492–0.497 through 8. The average is steadier, fluctuating around 0.467–0.480. In B, best-observed scores fluctuate, reaching about 0.507 at size 2 and the labeled peak 0.510 at size 6, then declining to about 0.480 at size 9; the average varies more narrowly, about 0.471–0.480.
